findings.problem: The example uses words not met before this card: Abend, gehe, essen. In the frequency phase it may use at most two words not met yet.

back.example: This evening I'm going out to eat with my friends.

note: An all-female group would be mit meinen Freundinnen, but the default plural Freunden is the expected answer with no hint; the trick is a grammar tip rather than a sound link, which is fine for a case card.
